items.description: This project collects data about telemetry in applications in machine-readable format and makes it easy to create derivative works such as awesome-lists, configuration scripts, APIs, etc. What you can do with it is only limited by your imagination. Here are several examples to get you started:
items.title: Usage

items.description: The page you see has an awesome-list of telemetry channels in various apps.
items.title: 📜 Awesome list

items.description: Scripts to disable all known telemetry channels in your shell session.
items.title: 🧯 Scripts

items.description:
Get telemetry configuration data via API! See openapi.yaml definition and try it online using RapiDoc.
Or try it in your shell! ⬇️
items.title: 🚧 API

items.description: JSON telemetry data format description: data/README
items.title: JSON data format

items.description:
If the tool you're using is not here you can easily add it by creating a new JSON file describing its telemetry data channels. Pull requests are welcome!
See CONTRIBUTING for details on adding new telemetry data and running tests.
items.title: Contributing
